# ─── NEUROSLOP ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Generated by Claude (claude-opus-5). Not reviewed by a human.
# Revision: stage 10 — mppcburner build.
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# mppcburner BURNS a disc: a prepared directory in, one .mppcdisc out. Named for
# the act, not the artifact — .mppcdisc is the disc, and a tool sharing that name
# would make every sentence in the documentation ambiguous.
#
# It compiles a game by GENERATING a CMake project and driving cmake/ninja, so
# cmake is a run-time dependency of the tool, not a build-time one. Writing our
# own build system to avoid that would be trading a dependency everyone already
# has for a pile of code nobody wants to maintain.

# The manifest front end is one stage per file, in pipeline order: lexer, parser,
# semantic analysis, binder — plus the symbol table and the failer they share.
add_executable(mppcburner
  main.cpp
  rv_burner_character.cpp
  rv_burner_manifest/rv_burner_manifest_lexer.cpp
  rv_burner_manifest/rv_burner_manifest_parser.cpp
  rv_burner_manifest/rv_burner_manifest_symbols.cpp
  rv_burner_manifest/rv_burner_manifest_semantic.cpp
  rv_burner_manifest/rv_burner_manifest_binder.cpp
  rv_burner_manifest/rv_burner_manifest_failer.cpp
  rv_burner_text.cpp
  rv_burner_manifest/rv_burner_manifest.cpp
  rv_zipwrite.cpp
  rv_build.cpp
  rv_inspect.cpp
  rv_burner_globs.cpp
  rv_burner_compile/rv_burner_check.cpp
  rv_burner_compile/rv_burner_common_helpers.cpp
  rv_burner_compile/rv_burner_cmake.cpp
  rv_burner_compile/rv_burner_compile_scripts.cpp
  rv_burner_compile/rv_burner_compile_sources.cpp
)

# The front end lives in its own directory, and the headers it shares with the
# rest of the tool (the schema, the text helpers, the character predicates) do
# not. This puts the tool root on the include path so a file inside the front
# end can name them plainly; the other direction stays explicit — code outside
# writes rv_burner_manifest/… so the dependency reads in the include line.
target_include_directories(mppcburner PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

# The contract lives next door. The burner reads pdk/cv/rv_texture.hpp for the
# texel formats it enforces budgets against, and pdk/rv_abi.hpp for the ABI
# version it stamps into a manifest.
target_include_directories(mppcburner PRIVATE ${RV_REPO_ROOT}/pdk/include)

# pdklib, for pdklib/rv_stdio.hpp and pdklib/rv_logs.hpp — the output adapter
# and the diagnostic layer shared with the console and with discs. Separate from
# the contract above because it is a separate tree.
target_include_directories(mppcburner PRIVATE ${RV_REPO_ROOT}/pdk/lib/include)

target_link_libraries(mppcburner PRIVATE libluajit)

# Stamps every log line with its origin; see pdklib/rv_logs.hpp.
target_compile_definitions(mppcburner PRIVATE RV_LOG_ORIGIN="tool")

# Where a GENERATED disc project should look for the contract and the disc-side
# SDK. Baked in so the tool works out of the box inside this repository, and
# overridable at run time (--pdk / --pdklib) so a disc directory living anywhere
# else builds just as well.
target_compile_definitions(mppcburner PRIVATE
  RV_BURNER_DEFAULT_PDK="${RV_REPO_ROOT}/pdk/include"
  RV_BURNER_DEFAULT_PDKLIB="${RV_REPO_ROOT}/pdk/lib/include"
)

if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(mppcburner PRIVATE /W4)
else()
  target_compile_options(mppcburner PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
endif()
